marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 20 knots backing to west 15 early this afternoon
then increasing to west 20 near midnight. Wind diminishing to light Friday
evening. Flurries. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
flurries. Temperatures near minus 3. <br/>
